task.title: QA: packaged launch diagnostics redact retained Chromium and app log lines
task.objective: Owner prompt 2026-11-11 (Phase N native x64 acceptance, step 2): review the packaged-launch diagnostic helper from 5bd4b9e2 for disclosure through retained log lines. Finding: watchPackagedLaunch keeps up to 12 raw stdout/stderr lines matching error/fatal/denied and prints them in the verifier failure message, and ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING also routes renderer console output to stderr, so absolute paths (which name the Windows user), URLs with query tokens, authorization headers, JWTs, key/value secrets and email addresses can reach console output that is copied into committed evidence. Fix: pass each retained line through the existing src/semantic/SemanticRedactor before truncation, and add a focused unit verifier, run red before the fix and green after. The npm script is registered under awkit-launch-log-redact-pkg-1111 (release owns package.json) and the classification under awkit-launch-log-redact-class-1111 (project-state owns the registry). No acceptance criterion, timeout, GPU, sandbox, security switch, product or packaging change.

acceptance.description: Retained launch log lines carry no user path, URL, authorization header, JWT, key/value secret or email; the diagnostic content (error_code, FATAL reason, exit code) survives; the new verifier fails before the fix and passes after; typecheck:scripts, build and verifier-classification PASS.

evidence.observed: 2026-11-11 negative control: the new verifier run against the unredacted 5bd4b9e2 helper exited 1 with 12 passed, 8 failed; every failure was a planted value surviving (a Windows and a UNC path naming the planted user, a URL query token, a Bearer value, a JWT signature, a key/value password, an email), and all behaviour checks passed. The red run proves the verifier detects the disclosure.

2026-11-11 after each retained line is passed through SemanticRedactor before the 240-character cut: 20 passed, 0 failed (8 redaction checks, each planted line still represented, error_code=18, Chromium source location, FATAL reason, stdout lines, exit code in decimal and hex, non-notable lines dropped, chunk-split lines joined, last 12 kept, 240 cap, signal exit).
2026-11-11 tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json clean with the redacting helper and the new verifier.
2026-11-11 roadmap snapshot, tsc --noEmit and electron-vite build (main, preload, renderer) completed; only the existing securityKernel dynamic-import notice.
2026-11-11 run under awkit-launch-log-redact-class-1111: all 376 verify:/validate: scripts classified (86 unit), no stale entries, classification reconciled.

history.released_reason: launch log lines redacted with SemanticRedactor, verify:packaged-launch-diagnostics red 12 of 20 before then 20 of 20 after, typecheck:scripts and build PASS
